name: Copa Vida - Del Mar
notes: 3 photos: 1 is a sharp coffee/tea drinks board (all legible); 2 and 3 are two differently-dated printed 'Food Menu' signs (DEL MAR 3/2026 vs DEL MAR 10.1.24) posted at the same location with partially overlapping items. Kept the newer (3/2026) Bacon Brekkie/Turkey Brekkie and added the older sign's non-overlapping items (Bowls & Salads, Veggie/Ham Brekkie, Vegan Mushroom & Cheddar Melt, House Granola Parfait) rather than duplicating. On the older sign, a 'California ... Ranch Melt' sandwich name and description were partly covered by a 'BE BACK SOON' sticker, a second Sandwiches item and the single Toasts item were entirely covered by tape (only a $13 price visible) -- all dropped as illegible per the never-guess rule. Bagel spreads/add-ons (cream cheese, jams, strawberries) and burger add-ons (bacon/avocado) skipped as modifiers. G. Lemongrass tea's price was cut off at the photo edge so it is listed without a price.
